options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.
options.doc_html_fr:

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.
options.doc_html_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

Full: s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

Minimal: s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Side Content Checks (old form)
options.doc:
Older form of the check toggles (any of Weapons, Challenges, Quests; [] = story only).

If set to anything other than its default, it overrides the toggles. New YAMLs should use the toggles.
options.doc_fr:
Forme antérieure des toggles de vérification (toutes armes, défis, quêtes; [] = histoire seulement).

Si défini à autre chose que sa par défaut, il outrepasse les toggles. Les nouveaux YAML devraient utiliser les toggles.

options.name: Goal (old form)
options.doc:
Older form of the goal (new YAMLs use goal_quests and goal_all_heroes).

Story: only the goal counts. Story And Side Missions: also goal_side_missions challenges or quests.
Story And All Characters: also every hero.
options.doc_fr:
Forme antérieure du but (les nouveaux YAML utilisent goal quests et goal all heroes).

Story: Seul le but compte. Story And Side Missions : aussi goal side missions challenges ou quêtes.
Story And All Characters: aussi tous les héros.

options.name: Goal Side Missions (old form)
options.doc: Older form: with goal: Story And Side Missions, how many challenges or quests must be completed.
options.doc_fr: Older form: avec objectif : Histoire et missions parallèles, combien de défis ou de quêtes doivent être réalisés.

options.name: Side Unlocks
options.doc:
Older form of challenge_unlock_order and quest_unlock_order (both at once).

Shuffled: both randomized. Game Rules: both vanilla.
options.doc_fr:
Forme plus ancienne de challenge unlock order et quest unlock order (les deux à la fois).

Shuffled: tous les deux randomisés. Règles de jeu: les deux vanille.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Game Mode
options.doc:
The shape of the run.

Standard: story missions, challenges and quests, as the other options set them.
Story Only: every check is on story missions (the Expansion Pass story too, with include_dlc). With
mission_unlocks: story_order each story clear opens one new random story mission; with mission_unlocks: items
(the default) they open by their unlock items, as in Standard. The goal is goal_story_missions clears;
goal_challenges is ignored.
Challenges Only: every check is on challenge missions. Story missions (except The Battle of Hyrule Field) and map
quests are hidden. A few challenges are open at the start and each clear opens 3-8 more; with
challenge_unlock_order: items each challenge opens by its own unlock item instead (12 start unlocked). The goal is
goal_challenges clears (0 = 50); the story options and final_mission_goal are ignored.

Both special modes open every service (shops, stables, dye shop, Smithy, Sheikah Sensor) from the start and spread
the checks evenly over the levels. Recipes become items (one per recipe); if quest_reward_items turns recipes off,
you know every recipe from the start instead.

options.name: Include DLC
options.doc:
Include the Expansion Pass (both waves).

The Guardian of Remembrance missions count as story missions (goal and unlock items), the EX challenges and quests
hold checks like the base game's, the DLC weapons are in, and Purah & Robbie, Sooga and the Battle-Tested Guardian
are hero items. EX Alerts stay playable but hold no checks (except Forgotten Temple).
If your emulator doesn't list the DLC, the client warns you; type /no_dlc to take it out of the goal and send its
checks, which keeps the seed winnable.
options.doc_fr:
Inclure le col d'expansion (deux vagues).

Les missions du Guardian of Remember comptent comme des missions d'histoire (objectif et déverrouillage d'objets), les défis et les quêtes EX détiennent des vérifications comme le jeu de base, les armes DLC sont dedans, et Purah & Robbie, Sooga et le Guardian Testé par la bataille sont des articles de héros. Les alertes EX restent jouables mais ne tiennent aucun chèque (sauf Temple oublié).
Si votre émulateur ne liste pas le DLC, le client vous avertit ; tapez /no dlc pour le retirer du but et envoyer ses vérifications, ce qui maintient la graine winnable.

options.name: The Future of Hyrule Is the Goal
options.doc:
Make The Future of Hyrule (the last story mission) the final goal.

It stays closed, with no unlock item, until you have everything else the goal needs (goal_story_missions - 1 other
story missions, goal_challenges, goal_quests and goal_all_heroes). Then it opens, and clearing it wins.
Off: the goal completes as soon as you have those clears, in any order.
options.doc_fr:
Faire de l'avenir de Hyrule (la mission de la dernière histoire) le but final.

Il reste fermé, sans élément de déverrouillage, jusqu'à ce que vous ayez tout ce dont vous avez besoin (goal story missions - 1 autres missions d'histoire, goal challenges, goal quests et goal all heroes). Puis il s'ouvre, et il gagne.
Off: le but se termine dès que vous avez ces compensations, dans n'importe quel ordre.

options.name: Goal Story Missions
options.doc:
How many story missions the goal needs, in any order.

The base game has 20. With include_dlc, the 8 Guardian of Remembrance missions count as story missions too (28).
A number above what your seed has means all of them. Post-story content still waits for the base story, as in the
game.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de missions d'histoire le but a besoin, dans n'importe quel ordre.

Le jeu de base a 20. Avec include dlc, les 8 missions du Gardien du Souvenir comptent aussi comme missions d'histoire (28).
Un nombre au-dessus de ce que votre semence a signifie tous. Le contenu post-histoire attend toujours l'histoire de base, comme dans le jeu.

options.name: Goal Challenges
options.doc:
How many challenge missions the goal also needs, in any order (0 = none).

Lowered to the number of challenges in your seed (challenge_checks must be on for there to be any). goal_difficulty
applies to these too.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de missions de défi le but a-t-il aussi besoin, dans n'importe quel ordre (0 = aucune).

Abaissé au nombre de défis dans votre graine (challenge checks doit être sur pour qu'il y en ait un). goal difficulty s'applique aussi à ceux-ci.

options.name: Goal Quests
options.doc:
How many map quests the goal also needs, in any order (0 = none).

Only quests that hold checks count, so quest_checks must be on. Lowered to the number your seed has.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de cartes recherche le but aussi besoin, dans n'importe quel ordre (0 = aucun).

Seules les quêtes qui tiennent les chèques comptent, donc les quêtes doivent être sur. Abaissé au nombre de vos graines.

options.name: Goal Needs Every Hero
options.doc: The goal also needs every hero unlocked.

options.name: Goal Needs The Hope of All Hyrule
options.doc:
The goal also needs The Hope of All Hyrule: every region's map 100% complete (every quest and challenge done).

A long goal. Logic expects every hero, every challenge and every quest of your seed first. With final_mission_goal,
clear The Future of Hyrule first (some of the map only opens after it); the goal is done once both are.
Not available with game_mode: challenges_only (map quests stay closed there).

options.name: Goal Difficulty
options.doc:
The lowest difficulty a goal clear counts on.

Each story mission and challenge the goal needs must be cleared on this difficulty or harder. A harder clear counts
for every easier one, so nothing has to be replayed. The client reads the game's own clear records; logic doesn't
change.
Any: any difficulty counts.

options.name: Challenge Checks
options.doc: Challenge missions hold checks.
options.doc_fr: Les missions de contestation ont des contrôles.

options.name: Quest Checks
options.doc: Map quests hold checks. Quest reward items need this on (except rewards the client gives directly).
options.doc_fr: Les quêtes de cartes tiennent des chèques. Les objets de récompense Quest en ont besoin (sauf les récompenses que le client donne directement).

options.name: Lab Checks
options.doc:
Every research node in the Royal Ancient Lab holds a check, and its reward becomes an item.

All 35 nodes are open from the start: the client removes the game's unlock order. Each node still needs its materials
and its own condition (such as "use Remote Bombs to defeat 100 enemies"), and the logic accounts for them. The two relic
nodes ask for The Future of Hyrule: with final_mission_goal they hold no checks. Needs include_dlc. Off: the lab is left as the game has it.
options.doc_fr:
Chaque nœud de recherche du Royal Ancient Lab détient un chèque, et sa récompense devient un objet.

Les 35 nœuds sont ouverts dès le début : le client supprime l'ordre de déverrouillage du jeu. Chaque nœud a encore besoin de ses matériaux et de sa propre condition (comme « utiliser des bombes à distance pour vaincre 100 ennemis »), et la logique en rend compte. Les deux nœuds reliques demandent L'Avenir d'Hyrule : avec final mission goal ils ne détiennent aucun contrôle. Les besoins comprennent dlc. Le labo reste comme le jeu l'a fait.

options.name: Weapon Checks
options.doc:
Picking up each weapon holds a check.

Off by default: when each weapon drops isn't fully verified. Story mission clears always hold checks; Korok seeds
and in-mission chests never do.
options.doc_fr:
La prise de chaque arme tient un chèque.

Off by default: Quand chaque arme tombe n'est pas complètement vérifiée. L'histoire de la mission permet toujours de vérifier; les graines de Korok et les coffres en mission ne le font jamais.

options.name: Side Check Density
options.doc:
The percentage of challenges and quests that hold checks, picked at random.

The rest are still playable but hold nothing. Lower this for a shorter game.

options.name: Region Hope Checks
options.doc:
Each region's "Hope of <region>" quest holds a check.

These quests complete by themselves when a region's map is 100% done. The Hope of All Hyrule never holds a check:
by then the goal is long done.
options.doc_fr:
La quête « L'espoir de <région> » de chaque région tient un contrôle.

Ces quêtes se terminent par elles-mêmes quand la carte d'une région est faite à 100%. L'espoir de tout Hyrule n'a jamais de contrôle :
d'ici là, le but est long.

options.name: Difficulty Checks
options.doc:
Extra checks for clearing missions on harder difficulties.

Every difficulty from Normal up to this one adds one check per story mission (and per challenge, see
difficulty_checks_challenges). A clear sends the checks of its difficulty and every easier one, so a Hard clear
also sends the Normal check. Ignored when difficulty_lock is on.
Off: one check per mission, on any difficulty.
options.doc_fr:
Contrôles supplémentaires pour le nettoyage des missions en cas de difficultés plus difficiles.

Chaque difficulté de la Normale à celle-ci ajoute une vérification par mission d'histoire (et par défi, voir difficulté checks challenges). Un clair envoie les vérifications de sa difficulté et de tout ce qui est plus facile, donc un clair dur envoie également le contrôle normal. Ignoré quand difficulté lock est activé.
Off: une vérification par mission, sur toute difficulté.

options.name: Difficulty Checks on Challenges
options.doc: With difficulty_checks: challenges get the extra per-difficulty checks too (story missions always do).

options.name: Difficulty Lock
options.doc:
Only clears on this difficulty or harder count.

An easier clear sends nothing, opens nothing and doesn't count for the goal; the client tells you to replay it.
Each mission's checks all come from that one clear. The Battle of Hyrule Field (cleared in the starter save) is
exempt. The client also raises the game's difficulty setting to at least this level (on the map).
Off: any difficulty counts.
options.doc_fr:
Il n'y a qu'à effacer cette difficulté ou à compter plus fort.

Un clair plus facile n'envoie rien, n'ouvre rien et ne compte pas pour le but ; le client vous dit de le rejouer.
Les vérifications de chaque mission viennent de celle-ci. La bataille d'Hyrule Field (effacée dans la sauvegarde de départ) est exemptée. Le client soulève également la difficulté du jeu à fixer au moins ce niveau (sur la carte).
Off: toute difficulté compte.

options.name: Mission Unlocks
options.doc:
How story missions open.

Items: each story mission opens when you find its "Unlock: <mission>" item, so the story is played in a random
order. You start with starting_mission_unlocks of them. Missions are not level-gated, so a late, harder mission can
open early. mission_order and side_missions_per_unlock don't apply.
Story Order: a mission opens once the missions before it are cleared, in the order mission_order sets.
options.doc_fr:
Comment les missions d'histoire s'ouvrent.

Items: chaque mission d'histoire s'ouvre lorsque vous trouvez son élément "Débloquer: <mission>", de sorte que l'histoire est jouée dans un ordre aléatoire. Vous commencez avec starting mission unlocks. Les missions ne sont pas nivelées, de sorte qu'une mission tardive et plus difficile peut ouvrir tôt. mission order et side missions per unlock ne s'appliquent pas.
Story Order: une mission s'ouvre une fois que les missions avant qu'elles soient dédouanées, dans l'ordre mission order sets.

options.name: Starting Mission Unlocks
options.doc:
With mission_unlocks: Items, how many story missions are open at the start.

One is first_mission's pick; the rest are random chapter 1-2 missions.

options.name: First Mission
options.doc:
Which story mission you can play first.

The client installs a starter save that skips the game's opening (The Battle of Hyrule Field is already cleared,
and its check is sent when you start). You begin on the world map with your starting heroes and this mission open.
Random Any: any story mission (it can be a hard one).
Random Early: a random mission from chapters 1-2.
Vanilla: Road to the Ancient Lab.

options.name: Mission Order
options.doc:
With mission_unlocks: Story Order, the order the story missions open in.

The client rewrites the game's unlock rules so each clear opens the next mission of the seed's order.
Shuffle All: any mission can be in any slot (The Battle of Hyrule Field stays first).
Shuffle Within Chapter: missions only swap places inside their chapter.
Vanilla: the normal order.

options.name: Story Party
options.doc:
Who can play story missions and challenges.

Free: your own heroes. When a mission forces a hero you don't have, the client swaps in one of yours, so four heroes
are always enough.
Vanilla: missions keep the heroes the game forces into the party, and you need those heroes first.
Borrowed: missions keep the heroes the game forces into the party; a forced hero you don't have yet is lent to you
for that mission only (unlocked while the map cursor is on it and during the battle, locked again afterwards).

options.name: Side Missions Per Story Unlock
options.doc:
With mission_unlocks: Story Order, gate the story behind side content.

Each story slot after the first needs this many completed challenges or quests per position (slot 5 needs 5 times
this number). Any completed side mission counts, check or not. Requirements your seed can't meet are lowered
automatically, with a warning in the generation log. 0 turns it off.

options.name: Challenge Unlock Order
options.doc:
How challenges open.

Randomized: a few are open at the start, and 2-4 more challenges or quests open after every completion (story clear,
challenge or quest). The client opens them in game. Heroes and runes a challenge needs still apply.
Vanilla: challenges open as in the game, following challenge_logic.
Items: each challenge opens when its own "Unlock: <challenge>" item arrives, like story missions with
mission_unlocks: items (needs challenge_checks; else it plays as Randomized). Adds one item per challenge.
Works in game_mode challenges_only too (12 challenges start unlocked); story_only has no challenges.
options.doc_fr:
Comment les défis s'ouvrent.

Randomized: quelques-uns sont ouverts au départ, et 2-4 autres défis ou quêtes s'ouvrent après chaque achèvement (histoire claire, défi ou quête). Le client les ouvre en jeu. Les héros et les runes doivent encore relever un défi.
Vanilla: défis ouverts comme dans le jeu, suivant challenge logic.
Items: chaque défi s'ouvre lorsque son propre élément "Débloquer: <challenge>" arrive, comme des missions d'histoire avec mission unlocks: items (besoin challenge checks; sinon il joue comme Randomized). Ajoute un élément par défi.
Fonctionne dans game mode challenges seulement aussi (12 challenges début déverrouillés); story seulement n'a pas de challenges.

options.name: Quest Unlock Order
options.doc:
How map quests open.

Randomized: a few are open at the start, and 2-4 more challenges or quests open after every completion (story clear,
challenge or quest). The client opens them in game. Reward items a quest needs still apply.
Vanilla: quests open as in the game (its story gates and quest chains; post-story quests after post_story_unlock
story clears).
options.doc_fr:
Comme les quêtes de cartes s'ouvrent.

Randomized: quelques-uns sont ouverts au départ, et 2-4 autres défis ou quêtes s'ouvrent après chaque achèvement (histoire claire, défi ou quête). Le client les ouvre en jeu. Récompenser les objets qu'une quête doit toujours s'appliquer.
Vanilla: quêtes ouvertes comme dans le jeu (ses portes d'histoire et chaînes de quêtes; quêtes post-histoire après post story unlock story cleans).

options.name: Post-Story Unlock
options.doc:
When post-story challenges and quests can open.

With a randomized unlock order, they join the random openings and can appear at any time (any value below 20).
With a vanilla unlock order, they open after this many story clears.
20: vanilla, after the whole story (with a story-only goal they then hold no checks).
Post-story weapon drops still wait for the whole story.

options.name: Challenge Logic
options.doc:
With challenge_unlock_order: Vanilla, when logic expects each challenge to be open.

After Story: once every story mission is cleared. Safe.
By Level: once the story reaches roughly the challenge's level. Shorter, but may be optimistic for challenges the
game opens later.

options.name: Weapon Check Logic
options.doc:
With weapon_checks, when logic expects each weapon pickup.

After Story: once every story mission is cleared. Safe, since drop timing isn't fully verified.
After Character: as soon as you have the weapon's hero and the mission that introduces the weapon is cleared.

options.name: Starting Character Count
options.doc:
How many heroes you start with, picked at random from starting_character_pool.

With story_party: Free, four is enough for anything; the rest arrive as items.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de héros vous commencez par choisir au hasard à partir de starting caracter pool.

With story_party: Libre, quatre suffit pour n'importe quoi; le reste arrive comme des objets.

options.name: Starting Character Pool
options.doc:
Heroes that can be picked as starting heroes (default: the 18 base-game heroes).

Terrako, Calamity Ganon and the Great Fairies are fine to start with. Purah & Robbie, Sooga and the Battle-Tested
Guardian need include_dlc.
options.doc_fr:
Héros qui peuvent être choisis comme héros de départ (par défaut : les 18 héros du jeu de base).

Terrako, Calamity Ganon et les grandes fées sont très bien pour commencer. Purah & Robbie, Sooga et le Guardian Testé par la bataille ont besoin de include dlc.

options.name: Minimum Character Level
options.doc: The level heroes are raised to when you start or unlock them (never lowers a higher level).

options.name: Catch-Up Levels
options.doc: New heroes join at the level of your lowest-level hero, if that's higher than their own.
options.doc_fr: De nouveaux héros se joignent au niveau de votre héros le plus bas, si c'est plus élevé que le leur.

options.name: Cap Heroes at Level 99
options.doc:
Cap heroes at level 99.

Heroes level up in game as usual (which refills hearts and the special gauge); one that reaches 100 is put back to
99 a few seconds later.
options.doc_fr:
Cap héros au niveau 99.

Les héros s'alignent en jeu comme d'habitude (qui recharge les cœurs et la jauge spéciale); celui qui atteint 100 est remis à 99 quelques secondes plus tard.

options.name: Start with the Sheikah Sensor
options.doc:
Start with the Sheikah Sensor, which points you to materials from the first mission.

Its quest (Needed: Researchers!) is already done and holds no check.

options.name: Start with Treasure and Korok Trackers
options.doc:
Start with the treasure trackers and the Korok tracker.

The Treasure Hunter's Technique, The Treasure Detector (and its upgrade) and A Most Peculiar Korok are already done
and hold no checks.

options.name: Shops Open from the Start
options.doc:
Every shop except the dye shop is open from the start.

Their quests are already done and hold no checks, and there are no shop items. Overrides Shops in locked_features.
options.doc_fr:
Chaque magasin sauf le magasin de teinture est ouvert dès le début.

Leurs quêtes sont déjà faites et ne tiennent aucun chèque, et il n'y a pas d'articles de magasin. Overrides Shops en caractéristiques verrouillées.

options.name: Stables Open from the Start
options.doc: Every stable is open from the start. Their quests are already done and hold no checks.
options.doc_fr: Chaque écurie est ouverte dès le début. Leurs quêtes sont déjà faites et n'ont aucun contrôle.

options.name: Dye Shop Open from the Start
options.doc: The dye shop (Dyeing to Make Contact) is open from the start. Its quest is already done and holds no check.

options.name: Weapon Fusion Item
options.doc:
The Smithy (weapon fusion) stays closed until you find the Weapon Fusion item.

Buying its quest is then a check. Off (default): the Smithy is open from the start.

options.name: Locked Features
options.doc:
Features that stay locked until you find their item.

Cooking: Hot Meals in a Pot (the quest that teaches cooking) opens with Feature: Cooking.
Shops: every shop opens with Feature: Shops (instead of one item per shop).
Fairy Fountains: the Fairy Fountain challenges open with Feature: Fairy Fountains.
Terrako Guardian: Terrako's Return opens with Feature: Terrako Guardian.
Features not listed open as in the game.
options.doc_fr:
Caractéristiques qui restent verrouillées jusqu'à ce que vous trouviez leur article.

Cooking: Les repas chauds dans un pot (la quête qui enseigne la cuisine) s'ouvre avec Feature: Cuisine.
Shops: chaque magasin ouvre avec Feature: Shops (au lieu d'un article par magasin).
Fairy Fountains: les défis de la fontaine Fairy s'ouvrent avec la fonctionnalité: Fontaines Fairy.
Terrako Guardian: Le Retour de Terrako s'ouvre avec le Feature: Terrako Guardian.
Fonctions non listées ouvertes comme dans le jeu.

options.name: Sheikah Slate Runes
options.doc:
The Sheikah Slate runes: Remote Bombs, Cryonis, Magnesis and Stasis.

Shuffled: all four are items ("Rune: Stasis" ...), hinted for free from the start. The Sheikah Slate (rune menu)
works as soon as you have any rune. Needs the Archipelago rune mod, which the client installs into Eden and
Ryujinx by itself while the emulator is closed (start the client before the game). Without it the game hands
runes out with story clears.
Vanilla: you get them in the story (Remote Bombs and Cryonis in The Battle of Hyrule Field, Magnesis and Stasis in
Road to the Ancient Lab).
Start With All: all four from the start.

options.name: Heart Containers per Character
options.doc: Heart Container items per hero (each adds hearts to that hero).
options.doc_fr: Heart Container articles par héros (chacun ajoute des cœurs à ce héros).

options.name: Combo Upgrades per Character
options.doc:
Combo Upgrade items per hero.

The world-map quests that teach combos become checks, and a hero's combo levels (up to 5) come only from these
items. With 5, each item is one level; with fewer, each item gives its share (1 = every combo at once).
0: combo upgrades stay vanilla.
options.doc_fr:
Combo Upgrade items par héros.

Les quêtes de la carte du monde qui enseignent les combos deviennent des vérifications, et les niveaux de combo d'un héros (jusqu'à 5) viennent seulement de ces articles. Avec 5, chaque élément est d'un niveau ; avec moins, chaque élément donne sa part (1 = chaque combo à la fois).
0: les améliorations combo restent vanille.

options.name: Special Gauge Upgrades per Character
options.doc: Special Gauge Upgrade items per hero (a bigger special-attack gauge).

options.name: Enhanced Abilities per Character
options.doc: Enhanced Ability items per hero (the skill-tree perks for that hero's unique ability).
options.doc_fr: Éléments de capacité améliorés par héros (les avantages de l'arbre de compétences pour la capacité unique de ce héros).

options.name: Weapon Capacity Upgrades
options.doc: Progressive Weapon Capacity items (each lets you carry more weapons).
options.doc_fr: Arme progressive Articles de capacité (chacun vous permet de porter plus d'armes).

options.name: Seal Slot Upgrades
options.doc:
Progressive Seal Slot items: the game's two seal-removal upgrades.

Those upgrades (from Caring for the Statues and Secret of the Rito Artisans) then come only from these items.
0: they follow quest_reward_items instead.
options.doc_fr:
Progressive Seal Slot items: le jeu est deux améliorations en retrait de sceau.

Ces mises à jour (de Caring pour les Statues et Secret des Artisans Rito) ne viennent alors que de ces articles.
0: Ils suivent plutôt les éléments quest reward items.

options.name: Weapon Items
options.doc:
How many specific weapons are also items, so other players can send you one.

The rest of the roughly 150 weapons are found in game as usual. Weapons never gate progress.
options.doc_fr:

options.name: Quest Reward Items
options.doc:
Quest rewards that become items (0 = that reward stays vanilla). Buying a quest is always its check.

Rewards that just raise a number (hearts, lessons, apple capacity, seal slots...) are progressive: the value is how
many copies, and each copy gives its share of the group's quests, in the game's order.
Groups of different rewards (recipes, shops, stables, regional discounts, Smithy upgrades, research quests, dyes,
Divine Beast upgrades, Expansion Pass reward quests) become one item per reward, named after its quest (for
example "Recipe (A Feast of Greens)"): any value above 0 turns on the whole group.
Rewards are given by their items directly; buying the quest only sends its check. Maz Koshia's trials are the one
exception: each trial is the next fight, so its quest stays closed until the item arrives.
By default every group is on except shops and stables. Groups other than the directly-given ones need
quest_checks.

options.doc_fr:
Quest récompenses qui deviennent des articles (0 = cette récompense reste vanille). Acheter une quête est toujours son chèque.

Les récompenses qui ne font qu'augmenter un nombre (cœurs, leçons, capacité des pommes, scellements...) sont progressives : la valeur est combien d'exemplaires, et chaque copie donne sa part des quêtes du groupe, dans l'ordre du jeu.
Groupes de récompenses différentes (recettes, magasins, écuries, rabais régionaux, mises à niveau Smithy, quêtes de recherche, colorants, mises à niveau Divine Beast, quêtes de récompenses Expansion Pass) deviennent un article par récompense, nommé d'après sa quête (par exemple "Recipe (A Feast of Greens)"): toute valeur supérieure à 0 tourne sur l'ensemble du groupe.
Les récompenses sont données directement par leurs articles; l'achat de la quête n'envoie que son chèque. Les procès de Maz Koshia sont la seule exception : chaque procès est le prochain combat, donc sa quête reste fermée jusqu'à l'arrivée de l'article.
Par défaut, chaque groupe est sur sauf les magasins et les écuries. Les groupes autres que ceux directement donnés ont besoin de quest checks.

options.doc:
How often each filler item fills the pool (0 removes it).

Character XP Gift: levels up a hero.
Extra Weapon / Weapon Bundle / Large Weapon Bundle: 1 / 3 / 5 random weapons, each for a different hero.
Small Material Bundle / Material Bundle / Large Material Bundle: 10 each of 3 / 15 each of 5 / 25 each of 8
materials.
Rupee Pouch: 1000 rupees. Hearty Meal: cooking ingredients.
Weapon XP Gift (older seeds) gives 1 weapon.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de fois chaque élément de remplissage remplit la piscine (0 le retire).

Character XP Gift: Il élève un héros.
Armes supplémentaires / Ensemble d'armes / Grand ensemble d'armes : 1 / 3 / 5 armes aléatoires, chacune pour un héros différent.
Petit lot de matériaux / Ensemble de matériaux / Grand lot de matériaux: 10 chacun de 3 / 15 chacun de 5 / 25 chacun de 8 matériaux.
Rupee Pouch: 1000 roupies. Repas copieux: ingrédients de cuisson.
Arme XP Cadeau (graines anciennes) donne 1 arme.

options.name: Local Filler
options.doc: Keep your filler items in your own world, so they don't crowd other players' worlds.
options.doc_fr: Gardez vos articles de remplissage dans votre propre monde, afin qu'ils ne foulent pas les mondes des autres joueurs.

options.name: Mission Rewards
options.doc:
The materials a mission gives on its first clear (shown on the mission card).

Vanilla: unchanged.
Shuffled: each mission gives another mission's rewards (fixed per seed).
None: missions give no reward materials.
The client changes the game's reward table while it's connected; logic isn't affected.

options.name: Auto-Hint Mission Unlocks
options.doc: With mission_unlocks: Items, every "Unlock: <mission>" item is hinted for free when the room starts.

options.name: Auto-Hint Heroes
options.doc: Every hero you can receive is hinted for free when the room starts.
options.doc_fr: Chaque héros que vous pouvez recevoir est indiqué gratuitement lorsque la chambre commence.

options.name: Free Hint Every N Missions
options.doc: A free hint for one of your unchecked locations every this many story clears. 0 turns it off.
options.doc_fr: Un indice gratuit pour l'un de vos emplacements non vérifiés chaque tant d'histoires effacer. 0 l'éteint.

options.name: Stuck Rescue Minutes
options.doc:
A free hint when you've found nothing for this many minutes.

If you send no new check for this long while connected, the client hints one of your unchecked locations, so you
always have a next target. It fires once per quiet spell. 0 turns it off.
options.doc_fr:
Un indice gratuit quand vous n'avez rien trouvé depuis tant de minutes.

Si vous n'envoyez pas de nouveau chèque pendant cette période de connexion, le client indique un de vos emplacements non vérifiés, donc vous avez toujours une prochaine cible. Il tire une fois par sort tranquille. 0 l'éteint.

options.name: Goal Progress Banner
options.doc:
A banner at the top of the emulator window with your goal progress and what to do next.

It shows on the world map: story missions, challenges and side missions still needed, the goal difficulty, and
setup steps while you start the game. Type "/goal_banner on" or "/goal_banner off" in the client to change it for
your own game.
options.doc_fr:
Une bannière en haut de la fenêtre de l'émulateur avec votre progression de but et que faire ensuite.

Il montre sur la carte du monde: les missions d'histoire, les défis et les missions secondaires encore nécessaires, la difficulté d'objectif, et les étapes de configuration pendant que vous commencez le jeu. Tapez "/goal banner on" ou "/goal banner off" dans le client pour le modifier pour votre propre jeu.

options.name: Frame Rate
options.doc:
The game's frame rate in gameplay, set by the client, with the game kept at real-time speed at any frame rate.

60, 120, Unlimited: draw up to that many frames a second while you play (cutscenes, menus and the world map stay at
the game's own 30). The game advances its time in 1/60 s steps; the client chooses how many steps each drawn frame
takes, so a PC that draws 45 frames still plays at full speed, and above 60 some frames take none.
30: the game's own 30 FPS.
Off: the client leaves the frame rate alone (for another frame-rate mod).
Type "/fps 60", "/fps 120", "/fps unlimited", "/fps 30", "/fps off" or "/fps seed" in the client to change it for
your own game.

options.name: Featured Challenge
options.doc: One random challenge is the featured challenge: its check always holds a progression item.
options.doc_fr: Un défi aléatoire est le défi en vedette : sa vérification tient toujours un élément de progression.

options.name: Steady Rewards
options.doc:
Story mission clears never hold filler from your own world.

Every clear pays out a hero, upgrade or weapon (or another player's item); your filler goes to side checks instead.
Skipped automatically if your pool has too few real items.

options.name: Story Pacing
options.doc:
Spread your heroes, upgrades and weapons evenly over the story.

This percentage of them is placed in your own story-time checks, one wave per story mission, instead of anywhere
in the multiworld. 0 = fully random. Ignored with story_party: Vanilla (the forced heroes already pace the story).
